name: OSTI Research Agent
description: Researches specific questions across the OSTI scientific-report database, the open scholarly literature (OpenAlex/arXiv), and the web, extracting evidence from paper text, tables, and figures.

skills.name: Search Literature
skills.description: Search OSTI, the open scholarly literature (OpenAlex/arXiv), and the web for peer-reviewed publications, experimental data, and research findings to answer specific questions about material properties, operating parameters, or engineering phenomena; extracts quantitative evidence from tables and figures and cites its sources
skills.usage_notes: Use when you need published experimental data, peer-reviewed research, or information not available in the material database. Long-running operation - reserve for questions requiring literature support. Prior research is reused to target sources faster; findings are always re-verified against the papers
skills.output_format: JSON with answer, provenance (source papers), and citations

question.description: Research question to answer (e.g., 'What is the creep rate of stainless steel 316 at 400C and 15MPa?', 'What operating temperature is safe for TRISO fuel?')
